58436-multitude-and-solitude.title: Solitude
58436-multitude-and-solitude.creator: Unknown
58436-multitude-and-solitude.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. his lines, forgot a few words, or improvised others. He drew in his breath sharply, whenever this happened, it was like a false note in music; but he knew that he was the only person there who felt the discord. He found himself admiring the address of these actors; they had nerve; they carried on the play, though their memories were a whirl of old tags all jumbled together.

71032-fanciful-tales.title: Fanciful Tales
71032-fanciful-tales.creator: Frank R. Stockton
71032-fanciful-tales.description: A book by Frank R. Stockton. But now, for a year or more, Old Pipes had not piped the cattle home. It is true that every afternoon he sat upon the rock and played upon his pipes; but the cattle did not hear him. He had grown old, and his breath was feeble.

arxiv-2103-12876.title: Complex Factoid Question Answering with a Free-Text Knowledge Graph Conference: Proceedings of The Web Conference 2020; April 20–24, 2020; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of The Web Conference 2020 (WWW ’20), April 20–24, 2020, Taipei, Taiwan DOI: 10.1145/3366423.3380197 ISBN: 978-1-4503-7023-3/20/04 Tha
arxiv-2103-12876.creator: Chen Zhao, Chenyan Xiong, Xin Qian, Jordan Boyd-Graber †
arxiv-2103-12876.description: Abstract . We introduce delft , a factoid question answering system which combines the nuance and depth of knowledge graph question answering approaches with the broader coverage of free-text. delft builds a free-text knowledge graph from Wikipedia, with entities as nodes and sentences in which entities co-occur as edges.

arxiv-2112-00208.title: Analyzing the effect of cell rearrangement on Delta-Notch pattern formation
arxiv-2112-00208.creator: Toshiki Oguma, Hisako Takigawa-Imamura, Tomoyasu Shinoda, Shuntaro Ogura, Akiyoshi Uemura, Takaki Miyata, Philip K. Maini, Takashi Miura
arxiv-2112-00208.description: Abstract The Delta-Notch system plays a vital role in a number of areas in biology and typically forms a salt and pepper pattern in which cells strongly expressing Delta and cells strongly expressing Notch are alternately aligned via lateral inhibition.

arxiv-2201-08768.title: On probability-raising causality in Markov decision processes Thanks: This work was funded by DFG grant 389792660 as part of TRR 248, the Cluster of Excellence EXC 2050/1 (CeTI, project ID 390696704, as part of Germany’s Excellence Strategy), DFG-projects BA-1679/11-1 and BA-1679/12-1,and the RTG Qu
arxiv-2201-08768.creator: Christel Baier(✉), Florian Funke, Jakob Piribauer(✉), Robin Ziemek(✉)
arxiv-2201-08768.description: Abstract The purpose of this paper is to introduce a notion of causality in Markov decision processes based on the probability-raising principle and to analyze its algorithmic properties. The latter includes algorithms for checking cause-effect relationships and the existence of probability-raising causes for given effect scenarios.

arxiv-2309-02994.title: An Offline Learning Approach to Propagator Models
arxiv-2309-02994.creator: Eyal Neuman, Wolfgang Stockinger, Yufei Zhang
arxiv-2309-02994.description: Abstract We consider an offline learning problem for an agent who first estimates an unknown price impact kernel from a static dataset, and then designs strategies to liquidate a risky asset while creating transient price impact. We propose a novel approach for a nonparametric estimation of the propagator from a dataset containing correlated price trajectories, trading signals and metaorders.

arxiv-2309-09331.title: Efficiency of Feynman’s quantum computer
arxiv-2309-09331.creator: R. J. Costales, A. Gunning, T. Dorlas
arxiv-2309-09331.description: Abstract Feynman’s circuit-to-Hamiltonian construction enables the mapping of a quantum circuit to a time-independent Hamiltonian. This model introduces a Hilbert space made from an ancillary clock register tracking the progress of the computation. In this paper, we explore the efficiency, or run-time, of a quantum computer that directly implements the clock system.

arxiv-2309-15644.title: Ultra High Energy Cosmic Rays from Tidal Disruption Events
arxiv-2309-15644.creator: and P. Beniamini
arxiv-2309-15644.description: Abstract The tidal disruption event AT2018hyz, was a regular optically detected one with no special prompt features. However, almost three years after the disruption it suddenly displayed a fast-rising radio flare. The flare is most naturally interpreted as arising from an off-axis relativistic jet.

arxiv-2311-06364.title: Relation Extraction in underexplored biomedical domains: A diversity-optimised sampling and synthetic data generation approach
arxiv-2311-06364.creator: Maxime Delmas, Magdalena Wysocka, André Freitas
arxiv-2311-06364.description: Abstract Abstract The sparsity of labelled data is an obstacle to the development of Relation Extraction models and the completion of databases in various biomedical areas. While being of high interest in drug-discovery, the natural-products literature, reporting the identification of potential bioactive compounds from organisms, is a concrete example of such an overlooked topic.

arxiv-2403-06339.title: FOAA: Flattened Outer Arithmetic Attention for Multimodal Tumor Classification
arxiv-2403-06339.creator: Omnia Alwazzan ⋆†, Ioannis Patras ⋆†, Gregory Slabaugh ⋆†
arxiv-2403-06339.description: Abstract Fusion of multimodal healthcare data holds great promise to provide a holistic view of a patient’s health, taking advantage of the complementarity of different modalities while leveraging their correlation. This paper proposes a simple and effective approach, inspired by attention, to fuse discriminative features from different modalities.

arxiv-2406-10319.title: On constrained matchings, stable under random preferences
arxiv-2406-10319.creator: Boris Pittel
arxiv-2406-10319.description: Abstract . Colloquially, there are two groups, n n men and n n women, each man (woman) ranking women (men) as potential marriage partners. A complete matching is called stable if no unmatched pair prefer each other to their partners in the matching.

arxiv-2501-03582.title: Exact Decoding of Repetition Code under Circuit Level Noise
arxiv-2501-03582.creator: Hanyan Cao, Shoukuan Zhao, Dongyang Feng, Zisong Shen, Haisheng Yan, Tang Su, Weijie Sun, Huikai Xu, Feng Pan, Haifeng Yu, Pan Zhang
arxiv-2501-03582.description: Abstract Repetition code forms a fundamental basis for quantum error correction experiments. To date, it stands as the sole code that has achieved large distances and extremely low error rates. Its applications span the spectrum of evaluating hardware limitations, pinpointing hardware defects, and detecting rare events.

arxiv-2508-07367.title: Almost a Complete Proof of the Generalized Erdős–Straus Conjecture: 5/a = 1/b + 1/c + 1/d
arxiv-2508-07367.creator: Bilal Ghermoul (1)
arxiv-2508-07367.description: Abstract . The generalized Erdős–Straus conjecture, proposed by Wacław Sierpiński in 1956, asks whether the Diophantine equation 5 a = 1 b + 1 c + 1 d \frac{5}{a}=\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}+\frac{1}{d} admits positive integer solutions b , c , d ∈ ℕ b,c,d\in\mathbb{N} for every integer a ≥ 2 a\geq 2 .

In this study, we developed a series of DNA vaccine candidates expressing different...

plos-pone-0004907.description: PLOS ONE research article. The pathophysiology of obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus is associated with abnormalities in endocrine signaling in adipose tissue and one of the key signaling affectors operative in these disorders is the nuclear hormone transcription factor peroxisome proliferator-activated

pmc-10571535.title: The Effect of Organic Trace Mineral Supplementation in the Form of Proteinates on Performance and Sustainability Parameters in Laying Hens: A Meta-Analysis
pmc-10571535.creator: Laurann Byrne, Stephen Ross, Jules Taylor-Pickard, Richard Murphy, Lin Xi, Massimo Trabalza-Marinucci, Yanling Huang, Kwanseob Shim
pmc-10571535.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simple SummaryThis work aims to highlight the importance of mineral form on production performance and egg quality traits using meta-analysis. Sustainability impacts, which focused on the carbon footprint of egg production, were also assessed. Results demonstrated that the inclusion of organic trace minerals, in the form of proteinates, positively impacted key parameters such as hen-day production, feed conversion ratio, egg mass, egg weight, and egg loss.

pmc-11340051.title: Pediatric head injury guideline use in Sweden: a cross-sectional survey on determinants for successful implementation of a clinical practice guideline
pmc-11340051.creator: Fredrik Wickbom, William Berghog, Susanne Bernhardsson, Linda Persson, Stefan Kunkel, Johan Undén
pmc-11340051.description: BackgroundThe Scandinavian Neurotrauma Committee guideline (SNC-16) was developed and published in 2016, to aid clinicians in management of pediatric head injuries in Scandinavian emergency departments (ED). The objective of this study was to explore determinants for use of the SNC-16 guideline by Swedish ED physicians.MethodsThis is a nationwide, cross-sectional, web-based survey in Sweden.

pmc-11437614.title: Investigating causal links between gallstones, cholecystectomy, and 33 site-specific cancers: a Mendelian randomization post-meta-analysis study
pmc-11437614.creator: Fei Teng, Youyin Tang, Zhangyu Lu, Kefei Chen, Zheyu Chen
pmc-11437614.description: Background and aimThe association between gallstones/cholecystectomy and cancer remains inconclusive in the current literature. This study aimed to explore the causal connections between gallstones/cholecystectomy and cancer risk by utilizing a bidirectional two-sample multivariable Mendelian randomization approach with Genome-Wide Association Studies data.

pmc-11503874.title: Mitochondrial Genomes of Korean Native Black Goats Reveal Shared Phylogeographic Patterns and Demographic History
pmc-11503874.creator: Gaeun Kim, Eundo Lee, Kwanwoo Kim, Dongkyo Kim, Seungchang Kim, Daehyeok Jin, Huimang Song, Seongsil Mun, Hankyeol Jeong, Jaemin Kim, Bonghwan Choi, Pietro Parma
pmc-11503874.description: Simple SummaryThis study explores the phylogenetic relationships among Korean native black goats, whose genetic resources are being preserved by the National Institute of Animal Science through the collection of purebred specimens. We analyzed the complete mitochondrial genomes of 282 native goats and 82 reference populations. The native population exhibits a haplotype diversity of 0.659 and includes 39 distinct haplotypes.

pmc-11508448.title: The Diagnosis and Management of Chronic Constipation in Italy: Results from a Survey Conducted among Italian Gastroenterologists
pmc-11508448.creator: Christian Lambiase, Lucia D’Alba, Francesca Galeazzi, Gabrio Bassotti, Danilo Consalvo, Edda Battaglia, Giovanni Cataudella, Maria Cristina Neri, Claudio Londoni, Piera Rossitti, Emiliano Valenzi, Bruno Annibale, Marco Soncini, Maria Caterina Parodi, Massimo Bellini, Stanley W Ashley
pmc-11508448.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Chronic constipation (CC) is one of the most common disorders of gut–brain interaction (DGBI). The management of CC requires specific skills due to its complex and multifactorial pathophysiology and its multistep treatment. The aims of this study were to evaluate the availability and the use of diagnostic tools for CC in Italy and the therapeutic management of CC by Italian gastroenterologists (GEs).

pmc-12853897.description: Replanting disease caused stunted grapevines growth, hindering the healthy and sustainable development of the grape industry. pmc-13043387.title: Platelets from early-stage Alzheimer patients show enhanced amyloid binding, an elevated open canalicular system and sex-specific differences in their activation profile
pmc-13043387.creator: Lili Donner, Julia Christl, Milenko Kujovic, Tillmann Supprian, Margitta Elvers
pmc-13043387.description: IntroductionAlzheimer's disease (AD) is associated with neurodegeneration and dementia. Key clinical hallmarksinclude the deposition of amyloid-ß (Aβ) into senile plaques in the brain parenchyma and in cerebral vessels known as cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA). Currently, anti-Aß antibodies are emerging as possible therapy for AD.

pmc-13476088.title: Longitudinal Evolution of Neuroimaging Findings in Fucosidosis: Expanding the Neuroradiologic Spectrum
pmc-13476088.creator: Rahul Nikam, Azam Eghbal, Terence Sanger, Emily Garavatti
pmc-13476088.description: Fucosidosis is an exceptionally rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by deficiency of α-L-fucosidase due to pathogenic variants in the FUCA1 gene. Neurologic involvement is prominent, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) frequently provides early diagnostic clues through characteristic white matter and deep gray matter abnormalities.

pmc-13675454.title: Red blood cell transfusion is not associated with lymphocyte subpopulation counts in very low birthweight infants
pmc-13675454.creator: Niclas Oßmann, Mats Ingmar Fortmann, Kirstin Faust, Julia Pagel, Martin Demmert, Christoph Härtel, Alexander Humberg
pmc-13675454.description: BackgroundVery low birthweight (VLBW) infants frequently require red blood cell (RBC) transfusions. Transfusions may modulate immune responses, but their impact on immune development remains incompletely understood.Methods120 VLBW infants participating in the prospective “Immune Regulation of the Newborn Study” (IRON study) were analyzed during the first 42 postnatal days with serial immune phenotyping. Infants were stratified by RBC transfusion exposure.
